fouls_log.foul_name: Direct Glass Out (Pared Directa sin Bote)
fouls_log.metric_detail: Ball struck back glass at X=-3.10m, Y=-2.36m on the fly without prior floor bounce
fouls_log.explanation: Stroke hit opponent's perimeter glass directly on the full without first bouncing on the court floor.
fouls_log.coach_correction: Add topspin or heavy slice to dip the ball into the court. Do not hit flat drives from deep defensive positions.

fouls_log.foul_name: Foot Fault on Service (Falta de Pie)
fouls_log.metric_detail: Ankle position: Y=16.25m (stepped 77.8cm across service line)
fouls_log.explanation: Server stepped on or across the service line into the court before ball contact.
fouls_log.coach_correction: Anchor rear foot firmly 30cm behind the line. Toss ball slightly back rather than chasing it forward into the court.

fouls_log.foul_name: High Contact Serve Fault (Saque sobre la Cintura)
fouls_log.metric_detail: Contact point was 65% up torso from hip axis (struck at chest/shoulder level).
fouls_log.explanation: Ball was struck above the server's waist level, generating an illegal downward trajectory.
fouls_log.coach_correction: Allow ball to drop below hip height after bounce. Keep racket head below wrist at impact to impart legal heavy slice.

top_technical_flaws.detail: Shot executed 5.9m from net. Lingering in transition exposes you to low dipping balls at your feet.
top_technical_flaws.coach_cue: Zone Discipline: Never stay in transition! If advancing, sprint to the net. If pushed back, retreat behind the service line.

top_technical_flaws.detail: Reaching too far in front; lost rotational power from core.
top_technical_flaws.coach_cue: Let the ball come slightly closer to your strike zone before unleashing the kinetic chain.

top_technical_flaws.detail: Knee flexion was 176.2° on a low ball. Bending from the waist causes errors into the net cord.
top_technical_flaws.coach_cue: Squat down with a wide athletic base. Lower your hips so your eyes are level with the ball trajectory.

top_technical_flaws.detail: Contact height was too low. Overhead shots require high vertical reach for steep downward penetration.
top_technical_flaws.coach_cue: Point at the ball with your non-dominant hand. Reach to full extension at 12 o'clock above your dominant shoulder.

assigned_training_drills.name: Net-to-Base Transition Sprints
assigned_training_drills.objective: Instantly transition between attack and defense without stalling in the danger zone.
assigned_training_drills.setup: Touch net tape with racket, sprint backward behind service line to defend lob, then sprint immediately forward to re-take net.
assigned_training_drills.coaching_key: Never stop running until both feet are completely behind the service line or inside the kitchen zone.

assigned_training_drills.name: Low Tray Knee Flexion Drill
assigned_training_drills.target: Center of Gravity & Squat Depth on Defense
assigned_training_drills.objective: Bend knees to 115° on low balls without hinging at the waist.
assigned_training_drills.setup: Place mini-cones at the baseline. Player must touch cone with knee before executing low chiquitas or wall returns.
assigned_training_drills.reps: 5 sets of 12 balls with rapid lateral recovery.
assigned_training_drills.coaching_key: Drop hips straight down like an elevator, not bending forward like a crane.

assigned_training_drills.name: Apex Reach & Vibora Extension Drill
assigned_training_drills.objective: Achieve full vertical extension for steep trajectory into opponent's glass.
assigned_training_drills.setup: High lobs fed from deep court. Hit smashes targeting opponent's corner glass with full vertical extension.
assigned_training_drills.coaching_key: Keep non-dominant hand pointing at the ball until right before impact; extend triceps fully.

assigned_training_drills.name: Service Line Footwork Discipline Drill
assigned_training_drills.objective: Maintain legal foot placement behind service line and center mark on serve.
assigned_training_drills.setup: Place chalk or training tape 15cm behind service line. Server must keep rear foot anchored behind tape through contact.
assigned_training_drills.reps: 50 practice serves focusing strictly on legal foot placement.
assigned_training_drills.coaching_key: Toss ball slightly backward so momentum carries into ball without feet stepping forward early.

4_week_development_curriculum.focus: Eliminating stiff knees and lowering hips on low defense
4_week_development_curriculum.core_drill: Low Tray Knee Flexion Drill (5 sets x 12 reps)
4_week_development_curriculum.success_metric: Knee flexion angle below 135° on 90% of defensive balls

4_week_development_curriculum.week: Week 2: Contact Point Timing & Unit Turn
4_week_development_curriculum.focus: Early shoulder coil and hitting 25cm ahead of lead hip
4_week_development_curriculum.core_drill: Wall-Rebound Early Prep Drill (4 sets x 15 reps)
4_week_development_curriculum.success_metric: Zero late contact points recorded off back glass

4_week_development_curriculum.focus: Full vertical extension on smash and bandeja
4_week_development_curriculum.core_drill: Apex Reach & Vibora Extension Drill (3 sets x 20 reps)
4_week_development_curriculum.success_metric: Exit ball speed over 105 km/h with steep downward angle

4_week_development_curriculum.week: Week 4: Tactical Zone Discipline & Foul Eradication
4_week_development_curriculum.focus: Zero time wasted in No-Man's land and clean footwork on serve
4_week_development_curriculum.core_drill: Net-to-Base Transition Sprints (6 rounds x 5 reps)
4_week_development_curriculum.success_metric: Transition zone occupancy under 15% and zero match foot faults

top_technical_flaws.coach_cue: Squat down with a wide athletic base. Lower your hips so your eyes are level with the ball trajectory.

top_technical_flaws.detail: Shot executed 5.8m from net. Lingering in transition exposes you to low dipping balls at your feet.
top_technical_flaws.coach_cue: Zone Discipline: Never stay in transition! If advancing, sprint to the net. If pushed back, retreat behind the service line.

top_technical_flaws.detail: Reaching too far in front; lost rotational power from core.
top_technical_flaws.coach_cue: Let the ball come slightly closer to your strike zone before unleashing the kinetic chain.

top_technical_flaws.detail: Ball struck 124.8cm behind the lead hip axis. Results in spraying wide or hitting the side fence.

assigned_training_drills.name: Low Tray Knee Flexion Drill
assigned_training_drills.target: Center of Gravity & Squat Depth on Defense
assigned_training_drills.objective: Bend knees to 115° on low balls without hinging at the waist.
assigned_training_drills.setup: Place mini-cones at the baseline. Player must touch cone with knee before executing low chiquitas or wall returns.
assigned_training_drills.reps: 5 sets of 12 balls with rapid lateral recovery.
assigned_training_drills.coaching_key: Drop hips straight down like an elevator, not bending forward like a crane.

assigned_training_drills.name: Net-to-Base Transition Sprints
assigned_training_drills.objective: Instantly transition between attack and defense without stalling in the danger zone.
assigned_training_drills.setup: Touch net tape with racket, sprint backward behind service line to defend lob, then sprint immediately forward to re-take net.
assigned_training_drills.coaching_key: Never stop running until both feet are completely behind the service line or inside the kitchen zone.

assigned_training_drills.name: Wall-Rebound Early Prep Drill
assigned_training_drills.objective: Eliminate late contact off the back wall and strike 25cm in front of lead hip.
assigned_training_drills.setup: Place 2 cones 25cm ahead of your lead foot. Feed rapid balls off the back glass; racket must meet ball precisely between cones.
assigned_training_drills.reps: 4 sets of 15 repetitions alternating crosscourt and down-the-line.
assigned_training_drills.coaching_key: Rotate your shoulders early so the racket is already back before the ball hits the glass.

assigned_training_drills.name: Service Line Footwork Discipline Drill
assigned_training_drills.objective: Maintain legal foot placement behind service line and center mark on serve.
assigned_training_drills.setup: Place chalk or training tape 15cm behind service line. Server must keep rear foot anchored behind tape through contact.
assigned_training_drills.reps: 50 practice serves focusing strictly on legal foot placement.
assigned_training_drills.coaching_key: Toss ball slightly backward so momentum carries into ball without feet stepping forward early.

4_week_development_curriculum.focus: Eliminating stiff knees and lowering hips on low defense
4_week_development_curriculum.core_drill: Low Tray Knee Flexion Drill (5 sets x 12 reps)
4_week_development_curriculum.success_metric: Knee flexion angle below 135° on 90% of defensive balls

4_week_development_curriculum.focus: Early shoulder coil and hitting 25cm ahead of lead hip
4_week_development_curriculum.core_drill: Wall-Rebound Early Prep Drill (4 sets x 15 reps)
4_week_development_curriculum.success_metric: Zero late contact points recorded off back glass

4_week_development_curriculum.focus: Full vertical extension on smash and bandeja
4_week_development_curriculum.core_drill: Apex Reach & Vibora Extension Drill (3 sets x 20 reps)
4_week_development_curriculum.success_metric: Exit ball speed over 105 km/h with steep downward angle
